name: Bankinter, S.A.
summary: Bankinter, S.A. provides various banking products and services to individuals, corporates, and small- and medium-sized enterprises in Spain, Luxembourg, Portugal, and Ireland. The company operates through Commercial Banking, Corporate Banking, BKCF Spain, BK Portugal, BK Ireland, and Other Businesses segments. It offers smart digital, payroll, pension, business, non-salary, currency, youth, current, and management accounts; debit and credit cards; cash management cash pooling; guarantees; mortgages and loan products; financing; and investment banking and wealth management services.
